summary: The media-codecs group has 163 files: 49 in system_a, 1 in system_ext_a and 113 in vendor_a. The system side holds the Stagefright and Codec2 framework libraries (32-bit and 64-bit), the media.extractor and media service executables, and a Mainline APEX (com.android.media.swcodec, version 319999900) that ships the mediaswcodec service, a Codec2 software plugin set, its own media_codecs.xml, init.rc and seccomp policy. The vendor side holds 29 Codec2 software plugins per bitness (each exporting CreateCodec2Factory), 14 legacy OMX software plugins (createSoftOMXComponent), Qualcomm QC2 layers (libqcodec2_*) including a V4L2 plugin, a Codec2 HIDL server library used by the vendor.qti.media.c2 HAL, a ClearKey MediaCas plugin, and XML/JSON configuration (media_codecs_anorak.xml, media_codecs_performance_anorak.xml, media_profiles_V1_0.xml, media_profiles_anorak.xml, media_anorak/video_system_specs.json). The variant suffix _anorak comes from ro.media.xml_variant.codecs and ro.media.xml_variant.codecs_performance in vendor build.prop. One row, system_ext_a/lib64/libcodecwrapper.so, is a protobuf wrapper for wearable input telemetry and is not a media codec. Several XML includes named by media_codecs_anorak.xml are not present in the mounted partitions.
